annotations.title: How to pay for a listing

description: How one listing is paid for and what it costs: steps per payment type, the cost (amount, asset, network; USD for recognised stablecoins) and a call recipe; steps the board cannot state are marked documented: false. With payer, the cheapest option you can use. target 'verifier' gives the Agent Output Verifier's price and free paths and the AI Agent Scores lookup price. Explains only; never pays. Free.

Payer.description: What the caller can pay with: an OBJECT with two lists, not a string.

assets.description: Token contract addresses (or Solana mints) you can pay with, e.g. USDC's - a list, even for one asset.

networks.description: CAIP-2 chain ids your wallet can pay on, e.g. ['eip155:8453'] (Base) - a list, even for one chain.

listing_id.description: Listing id (UUID); give this or target.

payer.description: Optional OBJECT, not a string: {"networks": ["eip155:8453"], "assets": ["0x..."]}. Picks the cheapest option you can use.

target.description: 'verifier': the Agent Output Verifier's own price and free paths.

trace_id.description: From a previous response, to continue it; omit on the first call.
